lines.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations!
For great is His loving devotion toward us,
and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico and Filippo Lippi, The Adoration of the Magi — peoples of every nation crowding in to worship
pictures.name: pd_angelico_magi

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, The Man of Sorrows Blessing — the hand lifted over us still carrying the wound it took for us
pictures.name: pd_memling_man_of_sorrows

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Ecstasy of Saint Cecilia — the choir of angels singing overhead
pictures.name: pd_raphael_cecilia
